newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lusotur blames '96 loss on real estate.
newsitem.headline: Lusotur blames '96 loss on real estate.

text.p: Portuguese leisure group Lusotur-Sociedade Financeira de Turismo said reduced sales of leisure real estate were a reason for its 1996 loss, which was deeper than in 1995.

"The consolidated net result for 1996 is a consequence of reduced activity in the area of leisure real estate, which was affected by the lack of available real estate products, and the closing of a golf course for renovation," a statement said.
Lusotur announced on Wednesday a 1996 loss of 1.04 billion escudos, compared with a loss of 0.9 billion in 1995.
Lusotur shares stood at 2,800 escudos, unchanged from Wednesday's close, at 1114 GMT.
